# South Hyderabad Properties

> Real estate advisors helping buyers and sellers find verified villas, apartments, open plots, HMDA/DTCP approved layouts, farm lands and investment land across South Hyderabad, Telangana, India — Tukkuguda, Shamshabad, Maheshwaram, Kongara Kalan, Adibatla, Kandukur, Immaguda and the Hyderabad Future City corridor.

Contact: +91 96469 52999 · southhyderabadproperties@gmail.com
